Biker killed in Delhi crash; driver arrested, minister orders action

A collision between a motorcycle and a car in Delhi resulted in the death of a biker. The driver of the car, identified as a Thar, has been arrested. The victim's family is seeking justice, and a state minister has ordered action against the driver.
